speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work confirms a significant bacterial infection with neutrophilia, but I need to confirm if you have any high fever or chills, which would strongly suggest pneumonia. Also, have you noticed any blood in your sputum? REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Left chest pain. I also have Productive cough with purulent sputum, Shortness of breath.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your recent history of untreated influenza, current leukocytosis with neutrophilia, and purulent sputum, I need to determine if there is an abscess or empyema. Do you have a history of smoking or any underlying lung conditions like COPD? REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Diagnosed with influenza recently, with non-compliance to treatment. No other significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: Non-smoker, occasional alcohol intake. Occupation and hobbies not specified.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (post-influenza bacterial superinfection).
